newsitem.title: UK: Sears seen firmer on talk of break-up bid.
newsitem.headline: Sears seen firmer on talk of break-up bid.

text.p: Shares in Sears Plc were expected to open firmer on Monday following press reports that a 1.6 billion stg break-up bid for the UK retail group is imminent, dealers said.
Reports said a buyer for Sears' Freemans mail order unit was already lined up and was prepared to pay 500 million stg.
Sears chief executive Liam Strong was quoted in the weekend press as saying the unit was up for sale.
"We'll mark them up and see if buyers come in, but they've already had quite a run last week," said one marketmaker.
On Friday, the shares ended at 96p, their highest level since September 17, and up 5p on the week. Call options on the retailer also were active.
